spec_match.rationale: HSTS builder emits the real Strict-Transport-Security grammar and validates against the actual hstspreload.org header requirements (max-age ≥ 31536000, includeSubDomains, preload token), including max-age=0 as the documented un-ship path.

interactive.rationale: Every control re-renders the header, rule verdicts, preload eligibility, and per-stack redirect config live; copy buttons use the real async clipboard API with an honest failure branch.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a validated HSTS builder plus 301 generators for four stacks; both sections deliver.

edge_cases.rationale: Preload-ineligible combinations FAIL loudly, max-age=0 is explained rather than treated as deployable, includeSubDomains risk is called out, and the ship-order section sequences redirect-before-HSTS.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite matches the page's framing; HSTS itself is a response-header behaviour that a static page cannot assert, and no assertion pretends otherwise.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP matrix both classes; autorun flips preload on with a short max-age and the screenshot shows the two FAIL lines plus red not-eligible verdict; zero console errors; clipboard fallback text verified by code path since headless denies clipboard-write silently only on some builds.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on header build (with validity flag) and on redirect generation per stack.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; verdict colours on stone backgrounds pass AA; buttons pair background with colour.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select/checkbox/input controls with 26px checkboxes inside 44px labels, output element tied to its inputs, aria-live verdict list, role=status copy confirmations, pre blocks focusable via tabindex for keyboard scroll.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow at 360 (generated configs wrap in pre with pre-wrap/anywhere); grid collapses; verified via CDP on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Add a live HSTS response probe against the showcase's own origin
openQuestions.detail: The toolkit generates headers but never fetches one. A small addition could fetch same-origin '/' and display whether the deployment itself sends Strict-Transport-Security (readable for same-origin responses), turning the page's own host into a worked example. Response-header visibility needs checking first.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button generated code snippet
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Explicit label/for associations; announce results of async actions; keep validation messages programmatically associated.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls labelled via for/id; copy results in role=status spans; rule verdicts in an aria-live list adjacent to the output they describe.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface validation state after interaction with text, mirroring visual state for screen readers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Preload eligibility re-announces via aria-live only when inputs change; FAIL lines are text ('FAIL'), not colour-only.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit grids and wrapping pre content instead of clipping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: grid2 auto-fit layout; .gen pre uses pre-wrap + overflow-wrap:anywhere with overflow-x:auto as backstop.

summary: Developer-facing migration tool for site owners hit by the new warning. Validation logic mirrors hstspreload.org requirements; verified interactively on both device classes via CDP with autorun exercising the failure path.
